# Reedly

> Reedly is the field intelligence platform for outside sales. Reps who cover a portfolio of outlets or accounts run their meeting; the mobile app (iOS & Android) transcribes the conversation with 95%+ accuracy, then automatically generates a report in 11 sections: executive summary, client profile, expressed needs, objections, commitments, next steps, opportunities, risks and recommendations, in under 2 minutes. The voice is neither recorded nor stored: only the transcript is used to generate the report. Every report lands in the Manager Hub, the web interface where sales leadership reads what the field is actually saying, account by account.

## Key Features
- Transcription during the meeting, or dictated right after, works offline (transcription and report generate as soon as the network is back)
- 95%+ transcription accuracy, holds up in noisy environments: a busy front desk, a counter, a showroom
- Structured report in 11 sections, generated in under 2 minutes
- The voice is never recorded or stored: only the transcript is used
- Speaker identification
- Auto-enriched client records
- Territory and region syntheses over any period
- Manager Hub: team reports, syntheses, member activity
- Max: AI assistant that searches the team's field data and can draft actions, emails and follow-ups
- CRM connectors (HubSpot, Salesforce), Slack, WhatsApp, email, PDF export

## Pricing
- Team: 49 EUR or 49 USD per rep per month (42 billed annually), from 3 reps, Manager Hub included, unlimited AI reports, priority support
- Enterprise: custom pricing (16+ reps), custom industry vocabulary, multi-team / multi-territory, dedicated account manager, on-site training and onboarding

## Audience
- Any B2B team that sells face to face: travel and tourism (the first market served: tour operators, wholesalers, DMC / inbound), industry and construction, distribution and retail, services and consulting, health and medical
- Field sales reps covering a portfolio of outlets or accounts to visit
- Sales directors and managers running that network

## Compliance
- Data hosted in the EU
- DPA available on request
- Sub-processor list published
- Encryption at rest and in transit
- Deletion on request within 30 days
- Participant consent built into the flow
